title: Event
description: The single event shape — docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md §10 (「single shape, one place」, verbatim field order preserved), written to infra/db/V1__init.sql `events` (lines 762-781) by the `record_event` tool (AGENT §3) and `POST /api/v1/events`. Spec §58 event tracking, §122 real-time events, §162 north star.

actor_id.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 `"actor_id": "uuid|null"` — null for anonymous traffic. Rule `event_actor_identity` closes the pairing.

subject_type.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 lists four values but its own required name list needs campaign/order/reservation/agent_run subjects; the superset is used (CONTRACT NOTES 2 in `src/enums.ts`).

session_id.description: Anonymous/browser session id — V1 `events.session_id`. Required for `actor_type: anonymous`.

properties.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 `properties: {}` — event-specific, snake_case keys (API_CONTRACT §1). Rules add the required members per event name.

event_id.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10: 「`event_id` (uuid) is the dedupe key — producers must retry safely」. Optional here because V1 generates one when absent (`event_id uuid UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()`); ingest callers SHOULD always send it.

id.description: V1 `events.id bigserial` — read-back only, never accepted from a producer.

degraded.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 north-star derivation ignores `degraded: true`; spec §105/§162.

EventName.title: EventName
EventName.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 「Required names」 — all 17, verbatim. V1 line 768 comments only 13 (and says `cart` where AGENT §10 says `cart_add`); the contract file wins (CONTRACT NOTES 1 in `src/enums.ts`).

NorthStarConversionEvent.title: NorthStarConversionEvent
NorthStarConversionEvent.description: The conversion subset of `EventName` — AGENT_CONTRACT §10 / V1 view `v_north_star` (line 1024) / spec §162.

EventSubjectType.title: EventSubjectType
EventSubjectType.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 `subject_type` superset — see the file header. Always paired with `subject_id` (rule `event_subject_pairing`).

GeoPrecision.title: GeoPrecision
GeoPrecision.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 `context.geo_precision`. Precise geo needs consent; the default for consumer traffic is `district` (spec §50/§112, AGENT §1 `location`).

EventContext.title: EventContext
EventContext.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §10 `context` = `{locale, device, geo_precision}` plus the open envelope V1 `events.context jsonb` documents (coarse geo, utm).

SearchEventProperties.title: SearchEventProperties
SearchEventProperties.description: spec §58 records 「查询词 + 结果数」 for every search, so a `search` event's properties must carry both. Enforced as rule `event_search_properties`.
